name: blyx-chaffinch
description: Run the Chaffinch workflow and merge sparse gradients from training workers in Blyx.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Chaffinch
walkthroughs.description: Run the Chaffinch workflow and merge sparse gradients from training workers in Blyx.

steps.title: Run the Chaffinch example
steps.description:
Create an empty .blyx file, insert blyx-chaffinch-demo and choose **Blyx: Run File**.
[Open the documentation](https://www.blyx-lang.space/packages/chaffinch)

steps.title: Merge sparse gradients
steps.description:
Extract the starter. With the documented compiler revision installed, run the scale example task.
[Open the experiment](https://www.blyx-lang.space/articles/training-in-factors)
